newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins track weaker US Treasuries.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins track weaker US Treasuries.

text.p: Russian MinFins eased on Thursday following the trend in U.S. Treasuries and Bradys on Wednesday's U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's inflation warning pointing to higher interest rates, dealers said.
"The MinFin market closed lower late yesterday after Greenspan's comments and the downward trend persists today, with prices tracking U.S. Treasuries," an Aljba Alliance Bank dealer said.
Dealers said the fall was not feverish, given no other negative news.
"News from Russia is good, so MinFins are strong but they are weak with U.S. Treasuries. All fixed income papers are going down following them," Eurobank dealer Olivier Coursault said.
